cohorts.name: Active writers
sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1792616825428
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826425428
    AND e.event IN ('document_created')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) AS n FROM ev

cohorts.name: Paying customers
sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1786050425430
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826425430
    AND ((CASE json_type(e.person_props, '$."plan"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(e.person_props, '$."plan"') AS TEXT) END) IN ('pro', 'team'))
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) AS n FROM ev
